description: a disc of radius 3 and height 1 with a conical boss on it, radius 1 at its base and 2 a height 1 above (so wider at the top), revolved whole about z, then its top cut away by the box above z = 1.5: the cone face loses its wide end, so its largest radius, which sets the chord steps of its u direction, drops from 2 to 1.5. The base circle between the cone and the untouched plane keeps its id through the cut, and must keep its polyline: it is meshed at the larger radius's step before the cut and at the smaller one's after, so the cone's neighbour and a face meshed earlier no longer meet (mesh_keeps; plans/per-face-tessellation step 1). The desired mesh of the kept edge is the same one before and after
